**Backend field becomes public** When a child state replaces an inherited backend-only field with an unannotated `dataclasses.field(default=...)`, this conversion creates a field with `is_var=True` instead of preserving the backend-only setting. The replacement is registered as a frontend var, so its value is sent to the browser. **How this was verified:** The replacement defaults to `is_var=True`, and state registration includes fields that are not marked backend-only.
